posts.title: “Parking, how does it work?”
posts.description: Yeah, just like magnets, the driver of this car doesn’t know how parking works. Pretty sure that one parking spot was not occupied when the Honda Odyssey driver decided to park in a wrong way. Well, I’m nice enough to redact the license plate.

posts.title: Anticipating new music for the rest of 2021.
